answer: Like a jetty holding firm against the tide of duplicate accounts, this stake-weighted barrier forces attackers to spend real resources per identity, making large-scale sybil swarms economically irrational while honest agents join cheaply. Sybil resistance can be anchored in a ferrous proof-of-work gate: each new agent must burn verifiable compute to mint a hardware-bound key prior to joining, so mass fake identities become costly. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
